research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Qualtrics is researching systems for generating action plans from perception gap data for interaction events and determining responses to real time user events utilizing user profile attributes. It develops digital survey creation by providing optimized suggested content and utilizing a knowledge graph to implement a digital survey system, including determining and applying attribute definitions to digital survey data, anomaly detection in ongoing data collection, and using machine learning to segment unstructured text and organize survey text responses. These efforts span survey optimization, analytics, and intelligent experience management.

overview_description.description: Qualtrics is a single system of record for all experience data, managing customer, product, employee, and brand experiences on one platform. The company's experience data, also called X-data, allows organizations to manage the four core experiences of business—customer, product, employee, and brand experiences—on one platform. Over 8,500 enterprises worldwide, including more than 75 percent of the Fortune 100 and 99 of the top 100 U.S. business schools, rely on Qualtrics.

about_short_description.short_description: Qualtrics is a single system of record for all experience data, managing customer, product, employee, and brand experiences on one platform.

product.name: Qualtrics XM Platform
product.description: A cloud-based experience management platform that collects experience data from surveys, calls, digital channels, and service interactions, then analyzes signals and supports actions across customer, employee, product, and brand experiences.

product.name: Qualtrics Customer Experience
product.description: A customer experience management solution for collecting omnichannel feedback, identifying friction and churn risk, and coordinating actions that improve satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and location-level performance.

product.name: Qualtrics Market Research
product.description: A research platform for gathering and analyzing market feedback, validating hypotheses, testing messaging and creative, and informing product, pricing, and go-to-market decisions.

product.name: Qualtrics Employee Experience
product.description: An employee experience management solution that gathers employee insights, supports action plans, and helps organizations improve engagement, frontline effectiveness, retention, and business outcomes.

product.name: Qualtrics Product Research
product.description: A product research capability for testing concepts, features, and pricing with market feedback before development, production, or launch decisions are finalized.

product.name: XM Data & AI Platform
product.description: An experience-management platform that uses organizational data and AI to simulate outcomes, predict behavior, and deliver governed actions.
